SARA: WPS ISSUE DOESN'T DEFINE ENTIRE PH-CHINA RELATIONS

Impeached Vice President Sara Duterte on Sunday, June 22, said the West Philippine Sea (WPS) dispute should not define the Philippines' entire relationship with China, as she called for a more balanced and independent foreign policy during the "Free Duterte Now" rally in Melbourne, Australia.

"'Yung problema natin sa West Philippine Sea do not make up our entire relations with China," Duterte told the crowd, as she urged Filipinos not to side with either the U.S. or China amid heightened regional tensions.

Quoting the Constitution, she said the country must pursue an "independent foreign policy that do not lean to a foreign power," and criticized moves to host U.S. missiles in the country.

"Hindi 'yung kikilingan mo—tama ba ang Tagalog, Ma'am?—kikilingan mo ang isang foreign power, papapasukin mo ang mga missile ng foreign power sa bansa mo, na alam mong kinaiinisan noong kalaban niya, na wala ka namang kinalaman sa gitgitan nilang dalawa," she said. "That is not independent foreign policy."

Duterte acknowledged the country's 2016 arbitral victory against China but stressed that enforcement should be done through diplomacy, not militarization. She said the Philippines should remain friendly with all nations, including the U.S., China, and Australia.

"Dapat 'yan—kaibigan mo lahat. Huwag kang kumampi, dahil hindi mo naman problema ang problema nila. Hindi mo naman away ang away nung isa," she said. "Dapat 'yan, balance lagi 'yung foreign policy."

LUKE JOINS MARIKINA PEOPLE'S PRIDE: 'PRIDE IS A PROTEST'

MANILA — Bukluran ng Manggagawang Pilipino (BMP) President Atty. Luke Espiritu joined the Marikina People's Pride march, sharing a photo of the event and calling on communities to resist rising global threats through collective action and political engagement.

"Thank you to the organizers of Marikina People's Pride!" Espiritu wrote in his post on Sunday, June 22. "As the world grows darker under the looming threat of war, it is up to us in the communities on the streets to get political and to fight for our right to live freely as who we truly are."

He ended the post with the reminder: #PrideIsAProtest.

🙏 Sunday Prayer | 1 Chronicles 16 🙏
 For My X Family, Friends & Patriots

Heavenly Father,

On this beautiful Sunday — a day of praise and rest — we come before You with hearts full of gratitude. Thank You for breath in our lungs, light in our eyes, and truth in our spirits. Thank You for family, for freedom, and for the fire of faith 🔥 that still burns in our hearts. Today, we lift up a shout of thanksgiving, just as David did in 1 Chronicles 16! 📖🙌

📖 “Give thanks to the Lord, call on His name; make known among the nations what He has done.” — 1 Chronicles 16:8

💥 We will not be silent! We will praise You, Lord, and declare Your goodness in a world that forgets!
💥 You are faithful from generation to generation, and Your mercy endures forever!

🤝 We Pray for Our Friends – Rest, Renewal & Revival in Their Lives

Lord, You know each heart. You see the battles no one else sees. You hear the prayers whispered in silence. Today, we lift up our friends and loved ones with love and expectancy. ❤️💧🛐

📖 “Look to the Lord and His strength; seek His face always.” — 1 Chronicles 16:11

🙏 Restore their strength, Lord.
🙏 Let peace flood every anxious mind.
🙏 Heal old wounds and renew dreams once forgotten.
🙏 May they walk in joy that is not tied to circumstances, but anchored in You.
🔥 We declare: Our friends are not forgotten. They are chosen, called, and covered by Your love. They will rise with courage, walk with grace, and live as warriors of light. 🌟

🇺🇸 We Pray for America – A Nation That Returns to the Altar

Lord, we cry out for our beloved land — the United States of America. Though many have turned from You, we believe a remnant remains — a people who still honor Your Word and long for righteousness to reign again. 🇺🇸📖🕊️

📖 “Declare His glory among the nations, His marvelous deeds among all peoples.” — 1 Chronicles 16:24

🙏 Raise up voices who will not bow to Baal.
🙏 Purify our courts, cleanse our schools, and ignite our churches.
🙏 Let the fear of the Lord return to the hearts of our leaders.
🙏 May revival begin in our homes and flow to our capitol steps.
🔥 We declare: America will not forget her foundation. The cross still towers over this land, and we proclaim boldly — “Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord!” 🇺🇸✝️

🌍 We Pray for the World – Global Praise, Global Peace, Global Salvation

Lord, Your heart is for the nations. From the highest mountains to the deepest valleys, let Your name be lifted high! 🌍🔥🕊️

📖 “For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; He is to be feared above all gods.” — 1 Chronicles 16:25

🙏 Awaken the hearts of every tribe, language, and people.
🙏 Break the chains of tyranny, idolatry, and deception.
🙏 Let Your Gospel run like wildfire through cities and deserts alike.
🙏 Let the groans of the earth be answered with the glory of the Lord.

🔥 We declare: The earth is the Lord’s and everything in it! 🌎🌿
From Brazil to the Philippines, from Africa to the Arctic — let all creation sing, “The Lord reigns!”

🎶 We Choose to Praise, To Proclaim, and To Persevere

Lord, like David who danced with joy, we too declare Your majesty. Let our lives be songs of worship, our voices be trumpets of truth, and our actions be offerings of love. 🎺📖💖

📖 “Give thanks to the Lord, for He is good; His love endures forever.” — 1 Chronicles 16:34

💥 Today, we will praise louder than our problems.
💥 We will trust deeper than our fears.
💥 We will love bolder than the darkness.
We pray this with passion, with power, and with unshakable faith —
 In the name of Jesus Christ,
The One who was, who is, and who is to come! 👑🔥🕊️

Amen and Amen! 🙏🇺🇸💖
